subject: Data Engineering
title: Build vs Buy
description: A quick win: understand Build vs Buy.

hook.text: Build a custom ingestion framework or buy Fivetran? The engineering team debates for three weeks.

buildup.text: Building in-house gives full control and customization. Buying saves time and maintenance burden.

discovery.text: Buy for commodity problems like ingestion and monitoring. Build for unique competitive advantages.

twist.text: The true cost of building isn't the initial code — it's the years of maintenance, upgrades, and on-call.

climax.text: The best data platforms mix bought tools for standard tasks with custom code where it truly differentiates.

punchline.text: Build what's unique. Buy what's common.

quiz.question: When should a data team build a custom solution instead of buying?
options: When the problem is a unique competitive advantage
When a commercial tool already exists
When the team wants more interesting work
